StarfieldCanvas.description: HTML5 Canvas/Three.js starfield with Orion constellation highlights, interactive pan/tilt, magnitude scaling, and fallback static stars mode

CentralDash.description: Golden pulsing dash that activates input mode via click, spacebar, or touch with ripple effect and privacy tooltip

DevotionalStream.description: Aesthetic conversation history viewer without bubbles. Displays gold Devanagari Sanskrit, thin line separator, and muted English text with smooth phrase-by-phrase typing reveal

InputPanel.description: Minimalist input field with voice recognition button (Web Speech API), prompt suggestions (e.g., 'Goddess of Time', 'Fierce Compassion'), and submit trigger

MinimalMenu.description: Discreet top-right navigation menu featuring Session Controls: Continue, Stop Generation, Start Afresh, Export Session (JSON/TXT), Clear Session, Audio Toggle, and Constellation Guide

MahakaliIntroModal.description: Discreet AI & Privacy disclosure dialog identifying 'An AI interpretation by Mahakali Studios. A fierce, compassionate, concise voice.'

AccessibilityBar.description: Accessible controls for reduced motion, text sizing, screen reader announcement live region, and keyboard shortcut guide

motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system settings and provide toggle in menu to disable ambient animations and render static canvas

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts in public/index.html or index.css for Cinzel, Noto Serif Devanagari, Rozha One, and Plus Jakarta Sans.
Ensure pure-black background (#000000) for the entire app body and canvas element.

Implement Canvas/WebGL starfield in src/components/StarfieldCanvas.js. Ensure Orion stars (Betelgeuse, Rigel, Bellatrix, Saiph, Alnitak, Alnilam, Mintaka) are explicitly plotted and optionally connected with faint gold constellation lines.
Position a single golden dash at center screen when idle. Clicking/touching/pressing Enter on it reveals the Mahakali Studios intro badge and activates the devotional prompt input.

Strictly avoid chat bubbles. Format responses in pure typographic flow: Gold Devanagari Sanskrit text at top, 1px horizontal gradient separator line in amber/gold, quiet muted English translation underneath.
Support full session controls in MinimalMenu.js: Continue conversation, Stop generation, Start afresh, Export session, Clear session, Audio drone toggle, Constellation toggle.
Implement Web Speech API for voice input/output so Goddess Kali's fierce & compassionate voice can be spoken or heard.
Add responsive virtual keyboard handling for mobile (prevent bottom bar overlaps using dvh or window resize visualViewport listeners).
Include data-testid attributes on every interactive element matching the specified test_ids matrix.
Add reduced motion support for accessibility, rendering static starfield when enabled.
